# Backgrounder: Strengthening Atlantic Canada’s defence capabilities in Newfoundland and Labrador

From:
[Atlantic Canada Opportunities Agency](https://www.canada.ca/en/atlantic-canada-opportunities.html)

## Backgrounder

The Government of Canada is providing an investment of $16 million under the Regional Defence Investment Initiative (RDII) to five businesses in Newfoundland and Labrador.

**March 19, 2026 · St. John’s, Newfoundland and Labrador · [Atlantic Canada Opportunities Agency (ACOA)](https://www.canada.ca/en/atlantic-canada-opportunities.html)**

The Government of Canada is providing an investment of $16 million under the Regional Defence Investment Initiative (RDII) to five businesses in Newfoundland and Labrador.

**PAL Aerospace Ltd.** St. John’s, Newfoundland and Labrador

Commercialize a new missionized aircraft solution to offer enhanced capabilities that strengthen Canada’s potential in maritime and northern surveillance, and Arctic sovereignty.

Investment: $7,500,000 (repayable)

**Virtual Marine Technology Inc.** Paradise, Newfoundland and Labrador

Develop and deliver marine simulation-based training solutions for defence.

Investment: $2,500,000 (repayable)

**Solace Power Inc.** Mount Pearl, Newfoundland and Labrador

Enhance capabilities in delivering wireless power and data solutions in harsh environments, including the Arctic.

Investment: $4,000,000 (repayable)

**CoLab AI Inc.** St. John’s, Newfoundland and Labrador

Deliver AI-powered collaboration software solutions to meet defence markets requirements.

Investment: $1,000,000 (repayable)

**Rutter Inc.** St. John’s, Newfoundland and Labrador

Develop and deliver enhanced radar technologies for naval and Arctic defence operations.

Investment: $1,000,000 (repayable)
